title: サンリオが特別調査委設置　常務の数億円不正報酬疑いで　通期決算発表は延期
extracted_text: サンリオは1日、常務が数年にわたって数億円の不正な報酬を受け取っていた疑いについて、社外取締役や外部弁護士らでつくる特別調査委員会を設置したと発表した。13日に予定していた2026年3月期の決算発表は延期する。 常務は斎藤陽史氏。指名・報酬諮問委員会が決めた報酬のほかに、自らが最高経営責任者（CEO）を務めていた北米子会社から報酬を得ていたとの内部通報があり、社内で調べていた。独立性と客観性を確保して調査を進めることが適切と判断し調査委を設けた。
translated_text: Sanrio announced on the 1st that it has established a special investigation committee composed of outside directors and external lawyers to investigate suspicions that an executive director received hundreds of millions of yen in irregular compensation over several years. The financial results announcement for the fiscal year ending March 2026, originally scheduled for the 13th, will be postponed. The executive director is Mr. Aki Saito. The company had been conducting an internal investigation after receiving a whistleblower report that, in addition to the compensation determined by the Nomination and Compensation Advisory Committee, Saito had also received compensation from the North American subsidiary where he served as chief executive officer. The company determined it appropriate to establish the investigation committee to ensure independence and objectivity in the inquiry.
title_en: Sanrio Sets Up Special Investigation Committee Over Suspected Irregular Compensation Worth Hundreds of Millions of Yen by Executive Director; Full-Year Financial Results Announcement Postponed
